security_audit.summary: All 41 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, relative documentation links, fixed workspace memory paths, and metadata URLs. The skill contains no executable commands, network requests, system reconnaissance, or uncontrolled filesystem access. It also instructs the agent to treat imported data as untrusted and to request confirmation before saving results.

remediation.issue: Automated scanners misclassify Markdown backticks and relative documentation links as executable commands and path traversal.
remediation.suggestion: Use explicit prose labels for code samples and keep related-skill links in a reference section; marketplace scanners should parse Markdown before applying code-execution rules.

remediation.issue: The skill may handle personal data in consent evidence, including IP and user-agent data when used.
remediation.suggestion: Collect only jurisdictionally necessary consent evidence, document retention limits, and direct users to obtain legal review before launch.

content.value_statement: Growing an email list requires clear acquisition choices and trustworthy consent practices. This skill creates a measurable growth plan with lead magnets, opt-in requirements, and referral mechanics.
actual_capabilities: Defines acquisition channels based on the audience, offer, and current signup source.
Develops lead magnet or signup incentive concepts that match the newsletter offer.
Specifies single or double opt-in flow requirements and consent evidence to capture.
Designs referral or recommendation mechanics with safeguards for signup quality.
Sets subscriber-growth, cost-per-opt-in, confirmation, and cohort-engagement metrics.
Creates handoff details for consent registry and email-flow design work.
limitations: Does not build signup pages, popups, or forms.
Does not write confirmation or welcome email copy.
Does not record consent or contact records directly.
Provides compliance guidance, not legal advice.

use_cases.title: Launch a newsletter acquisition plan
use_cases.description: Create a channel and lead-magnet plan before launching a new newsletter.

use_cases.title: Improve an existing signup funnel
use_cases.description: Review current sources and define measurable improvements to list growth and confirmation rates.

use_cases.title: Prepare a compliant referral program
use_cases.description: Specify incentives, attribution, consent requirements, and quality safeguards for referrals.

prompt_templates.title: Start a list-growth plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan email-list growth for my newsletter. My audience is [audience], my offer is [offer], and my goal is [goal] over [period].

prompt_templates.title: Design a lead magnet
prompt_templates.prompt: Design three honest lead magnet concepts for [audience]. My newsletter helps with [outcome]. Include the best acquisition channel for each concept.

prompt_templates.title: Specify a double opt-in flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a compliant double opt-in capture-flow specification for [offer] in [jurisdiction]. List the consent evidence to capture and open questions for counsel.

prompt_templates.title: Build a measured referral loop
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a referral loop for my newsletter. Current list size: [size]. Signup source: [source]. Include incentive, attribution, quality safeguards, and estimated metrics labeled clearly.

output_examples.input: Plan growth for a weekly finance newsletter for new investors.
output: Recommended channels: educational articles, partner webinars, and a social profile signup link.
Lead magnet: a beginner investing checklist that matches the newsletter topic.
Metrics: confirmed subscribers, cost per opt-in, and opt-in-to-confirmed rate, each labeled as user-provided or estimated.

output_examples.input: Create a referral plan for a local business newsletter.
output: Referral incentive: access to a local events guide after a confirmed referral.
Safeguard: issue rewards only after double opt-in confirmation.
Handoff: send consent-capture requirements to the consent registry workflow.

best_practices: Provide current signup data and label unknown values instead of guessing.
Use double opt-in when appropriate and document the consent evidence required.
Confirm jurisdiction-specific requirements with qualified legal counsel before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not promise subscriber benchmarks without user data or a clear estimate label.
Do not use misleading incentives or claims that the newsletter cannot support.
Do not store consent records outside the designated consent registry process.

faq.question: Does this skill build my signup page?
faq.answer: No. It creates the strategy and capture-flow specification, not the page or popup.

faq.question: Does this skill write welcome emails?
faq.answer: No. Use an email copy or sequence skill for confirmation and welcome messages.

faq.question: Can it recommend double opt-in?
faq.answer: Yes. It can specify double opt-in and explain the consent evidence to capture.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides compliance guidance and recommends qualified counsel for jurisdiction-specific requirements.

faq.question: Can it plan paid acquisition?
faq.answer: It can identify paid acquisition as a channel, but routes campaign mechanics to the paid marketing discipline.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the audience, offer, current signup source, list size, growth history, goal, and jurisdiction when available.
